On hearing this Du'a, such joy came over me that my head went and touched my lap.” When the Prophet ﷺ asked, “Are you this pleased with my Du'a?” I said, “How could I not be pleased with your Du'a?” The Prophet ﷺ said, “By Allah! I keep asking this Du'a for my Ummah in every Salah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَوْفٍ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: إِنَّ الدِّينَ بَدَأَ غَرِيباً وَيَرْجِعُ غَرِيباً فَطُوبي لِلْغُرَبَاءِ الَّذِينَ يُصْلِحُونَ مَا أَفْسَدَ النَّاسُ مِنْ بَعْدِي مِنْ سُنَّتِي.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: (وهو بعض الحديث) رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح، باب ما جاء ان الاسلام بدا غريبا...، رقم: ٢٦٣٠
blocks.tamil_translation: “This sacred Din began like an unknown stranger, and very soon it will again become like an unknown stranger, as it was at first. So glad tidings be to those Muslims who are regarded as unknown strangers because of the Din!' These are the ones who will set right my way which people corrupted after me,” Hazrat Amr ibn Awf (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قِيلَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ! اُدْعُ عَلَي الْمُشْرِكِينَ، قَالَ: إِنِّي لَمْ أُبْعَثْ لَعَّاناً وَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ رَحْمَةً.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه مسلم، باب النهي عن لعن الدواب وغيرها، رقم:٦٦١٣
blocks.tamil_translation: A request was made to the Prophet ﷺ to curse the Mushrikin, who ascribe partners to Allah. “I have not been sent as one who curses; I have been sent only as a Rahmah (one who shows mercy),”
